formulas.formula: Every income stream, brand deal and follower milestone in one place.
Setup: your name, the year, a tax set-aside %, a monthly goal and the rates you use to price sponsorships.
Platforms: each channel with followers on January 1 and now, average views and engagement.
Income: ad revenue, affiliate, memberships, merch and other money. Brand deals go on their own tab.
Brand Deals: every pitch and partnership. Add the paid date when the money lands and it counts as income.
Expenses, Monthly, Income Mix, Rate Card and Dashboard show where your money comes from.
Sponsorships come only from Brand Deals. Don't add them to Income too.
Put the agency % on the deal. Your take is what's left.
A starting point. Engagement, niche and usage rights can push it higher.
Creator income is usually self-employment income. Set money aside every month.
Keep creating. The money follows good work.

=IF(MAX('Income Mix'!C7:C14)<=0,IF('Income Mix'!C6>0,"Sponsorships","-"),IF('Income Mix'!C6>=MAX('Income Mix'!C7:C14),"Sponsorships",INDEX('Income Mix'!B7:B14,MATCH(MAX('Income Mix'!C7:C14),'Income Mix'!C7:C14,0))))

=IF(AND(R4=0,R7=0),"Add your platforms and first income to start.",IF(R8>0,R8&IF(R8=1," sponsored post is"," sponsored posts are")&" overdue. Deliver or ask for more time.",IF(R16>0,R16&IF(R16=1," brand owes"," brands owe")&" you money. Send a friendly invoice reminder.","On track. Keep creating!")))
Your channels. Followers can be subscribers, members or email readers. Income includes paid brand deals.
Money that landed, by date received. Fees = platform, processing or production costs taken out. Brand deals go on Brand Deals.
Your sponsorship pipeline. A deal counts as income once it has a Paid on date.

=IF(TRIM(B{row}&"")="","",IF(T{row}=5,IF(AND(ISNUMBER(I{row}),N(I{row})>=1),"Paid","Add paid date"),IF(T{row}=6,"Closed",IF(T{row}=4,"Waiting for payment",IF(T{row}=3,IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(H{row})),"Set a due date",IF(H{row}<'Setup'!$R$5,"Content overdue",IF(H{row}='Setup'!$R$5,"Due today","Due in "&(H{row}-'Setup'!$R$5)&" days"))),"Follow up")))))
What it costs to create: gear, apps, editors, travel, promotion.
